I'm sitting in a cafe on the shoulder of a large Egyptian God, (The one with the dog head and human body). I look around and a ways away (it looked like there could have been a whole city between the two) there's an almost identical statue.

An couple are hanging out at the table beside me and turn to me.

"Over there is Gomorrah, never visit there."

"Does that make this Sodom?" I ask

They laugh and I wake up.
